description: Machine-readable map of SOLIDWORKS LEO reported capabilities to MakerBench's deterministic DFM rule catalog. Prose source of truth: docs/LEO_DFM_COMPARISON.md; rule IDs are defined in docs/DFM_RULES.md.

capabilities.gap: LEO warns during feature creation; MakerBench scores the exported file. Compare whether LEO warnings predict actual L1/L2 failures.
LEO thresholds are not public; MakerBench publishes thresholds as task parameters, so disagreement is logged as a threshold/context mismatch.
MakerBench grades specific maker-scale catalog fits, not a full GD&T tolerance-stack engine; a future cetol-tolerance pack can cover datum/stack comparisons.
MakerBench grades the exported geometry and declared manifest, so it independently catches 'looks OK in CAD, wrong flat pattern'.
Sequence plausibility stays a dossier/workflow-track field until a deterministic sequence grader lands.
makerbench-core scores exported STEP envelope/shape tokens; deeper B-rep topology remains the optional-local brep-build123d path. Never requires a live SOLIDWORKS seat.
Only typed, exported requirements are comparable today; deeper parity waits on an open solver profile (future simulation-fea pack).
